training_notes.vrd_rule_triggered: PRD §4.2 — Any polybag with an opening ≥ 5 inches used for a children's product MUST carry a printed suffocation warning.
training_notes.why_this_matters: This is a children's soft toy. The DALL-E image correctly shows NO warning text at all — neither on the bottom nor front of the bag. This should trigger an immediate FAIL regardless of other checks passing.
